collectible.title: Carbuncle plushie
collectible.subtitle: You'd have to be brainwashed to believe it's the real thing.
collectible.text: It had an opening in the back, seems to be a photo of late in the game, with one note attatched: "Gu". You seem to think that's the little guy encouraging you to enjoy the view.
collectible.unlock: Make Arle lose the game and have her little companion hang around enough for him to help you get a "unique" view of her. Alternatively have her be the last one to "finish" before the game over screen.

collectible.title: Puyo Puyo Deck
collectible.subtitle: Quite colorful
collectible.text: A deck celebrating the characters and eras from the series!
collectible.unlock: Win a game with Arle and three other Puyo Puyo characters to unlock a special deck!
